page_title.zh: 毛一鸣 Aiming — 具身智能

role.zh: 破壳 Pokebot · 数据负责人 / 算法专家

intro.en: Embodied intelligence, from data to model pretraining.
intro.zh: 从数据到模型预训练，探索具身智能。

bio.en: I lead data work and embodied foundation-model pretraining at Pokebot, collaborating with Huazhe Xu on research and development.
bio.zh: 我在破壳担任数据负责人和算法专家，负责具身大模型预训练与数据工作，并与许华哲共同参与研发。

focus.en: My work spans autonomous driving and robotics, with a focus on data, perception, and model training.
focus.zh: 我的研究经历覆盖自动驾驶与机器人，关注数据、感知和模型训练。

projects.title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation

summary.en: Learning relative advantage from three simple labels—progressing, regressing, and stagnant—to guide policy training for long-horizon manipulation.
summary.zh: 通过“前进、后退、停滞”三态标注学习相对优势奖励，为长时程机器人操作提供动作加权训练信号。

result.en: Reported 99.4% success on long-horizon towel folding with GR00T N1.5 + ARM (AW-BC), under the paper’s evaluation setting.
result.zh: 论文实验中，GR00T N1.5 + ARM（AW-BC）在长时程叠毛巾任务上达到 99.4% 成功率。

summary.en: The V³-0 stack in COSA 0.5 combines humanoid whole-body mobile manipulation with human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning on real robots.
summary.zh: COSA 0.5 的 V³-0 技术栈将人形机器人的全身移动操作与人类在环真机强化学习相结合。

contribution.en: Provided support for data, models, and selected algorithms.
contribution.zh: 提供数据、模型与部分算法支持。

result.en: The official report demonstrates continuous room tidying and whole-body expert intervention on the Oli humanoid.
result.zh: 官方报告展示 Oli 人形机器人连续整理房间与全身专家接管等真机演示。

projects.title: FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence

summary.en: A modular engineering platform connecting embodied-policy data, training, simulation evaluation, and real-robot deployment.
summary.zh: 以统一配置和模块化接口，贯通具身模型的数据处理、训练、仿真评测与真机部署。

result.en: Open-source workflows for distributed training, accelerated inference, and human-in-the-loop correction; evaluation protocols are detailed in the report.
result.zh: 开源分布式训练、推理加速与人机协同纠错流程，评测设置与结果见技术报告。

summary.en: Track-centric offline LiDAR 3D detection, combining bidirectional tracking and temporal refinement to improve automatic annotation.
summary.zh: 以轨迹为中心的离线 LiDAR 三维检测，结合双向跟踪与时序精修，提升三维检测和自动标注质量。

result.en: Evaluated on the Waymo Open Dataset. Full title: Once Detected, Never Lost: Surpassing Human Performance in Offline LiDAR based 3D Object Detection.
result.zh: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 上完成评测；完整论文题名与实验结果见下方论文链接。

description.en: Open-source infrastructure for embodied-policy data, training, evaluation, and deployment. Includes VLA/WAM integration and inference workflows.
description.zh: 面向具身策略的数据、训练、评测与部署的开源基础设施，包含 VLA/WAM 集成与推理流程。

description.en: The official implementation of CTRL is maintained in tusen-ai/SST. The repository includes training and evaluation instructions.
description.zh: CTRL 官方实现位于 tusen-ai/SST，仓库提供训练和评测说明。

description.en: Project overview, manipulation demonstrations, method details, and experimental results for ARM.
description.zh: ARM 项目介绍、机器人操作演示、方法细节和实验结果。

description.en: Worked on general perception, occupancy, stereo vision, world models, and end-to-end driving. Mentored by Xuewu Lin.
description.zh: 从事泛感知算法、occupancy、双目立体视觉（stereo）、世界模型与端到端自动驾驶相关工作，mentor 为林学武。

description.en: During my internship at TuSimple, I received guidance from Yan Yan, Feng Wang, and Naiyan Wang.
description.zh: 在图森未来实习期间，曾受到闫岩、王峰、王乃岩的指导。
